notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source for the tower itself is the tnlandforms web list (GA027, no GFC or BLL number). Its notes say towers 1-72 come from the USGS name database, so the name is a USGS-era label; not checked against GNIS itself. The National Historic Lookout Register Georgia page (29 lookouts) does not list it. Elevation in the list is 146 with no unit stated; the record's 44.5 m assumes feet, not verified. Community background is from Wikipedia and a photo blog (Vanishing Georgia), which is a weak source. Status, staffing, access and history are unknown. Next step if wanted: a Georgia Forestry Commission or Mitchell County inquiry, or a field check of the coordinates. Added on verification: Wikipedia (cite 2) gives a different naming origin (the first settlers' hopeful spirit), so the story reports the blog and Wikipedia accounts side by side. The clause that a map entry alone does not show whether a tower still stands was removed as unsupported by any source read.
